evidence_required: hypothesis; both configurations in full; workload; one controlled variable; repetitions (≥ 5) and warm-up; metrics; analysis method; environment manifest fields; safety boundary; a "cannot conclude" list of at least four items specific to the model.

marking.criterion: Falsifiable hypothesis and both configurations in full, differing in one controlled variable
Metrics and counters, and an analysis method (median, spread, decision rule)
Environment manifest fields and the safety boundary
'Cannot conclude' list of ≥ 4 model-specific items, plus what the experiment would and would not establish

title: Design a controlled congestion experiment
